descripcion: This is probably the skill that limits spoken English most, and the least taught. Courses train you to produce sentences; they do not train you to get a turn, keep it while you think, hand it over, or recover when you lose the thread mid-sentence. Fluency is not speed — it is the ability to keep the channel open while you think.

filas: get a turn without waiting for silence
*Can I jump in on that?* / *Sorry, before we move on —*
*Give me a second, I'm working out how to say this* / *There's a word I'm looking for — bear with me*
*But you were going to say something* / *What's your take?*
fix a broken sentence out loud
*Let me start that again* / *That came out wrong — what I meant was…*
*That's a good question, actually* / *It depends what you mean by…*

ejemplos.texto: *Sorry, before we move on — can I go back to what you said about your sister?*
*There's a word I'm looking for, bear with me… estranged. That's it.*
*That came out wrong. What I meant was that I understood why she did it, not that I agreed.*
*But you were going to say something.*

notas: Announcing that you are searching for a word is a C1 move, not a failure. Native speakers do it constantly.
Silence costs more in English than in Spanish. Filled pauses (*right*, *so*, *I mean*) keep the turn.
Explicit repair is far better than trailing off.

contraste.es: Spanish conversation tolerates and expects more overlap and interruption than English does — but English compensates by making the *taking* explicit and verbal. Where Spanish simply starts talking, English announces first.

errores: Apologising for your English mid-conversation. It moves the listener's attention onto your level.
*Sorry, my English is bad* — never say this. Say *bear with me*.
Abandoning a lost sentence instead of repairing it aloud.
Waiting for a clean gap that never comes.

redemittel.funcion: takes it back to an earlier point

traducciones.fr: Désolé, avant de passer à la suite —

traducciones.pt: Tem um pouco de paciência comigo.

redemittel.funcion: admits the breakdown and keeps going

redemittel.expresion: It depends what you mean by…

traducciones.de: Es hängt davon ab, was du mit … meinst.
traducciones.fr: Ça dépend de ce que tu entends par…
traducciones.pt: Depende do que queres dizer com…

autochequeo: Did I take the floor verbally, or wait for a gap?
Did I hold a turn while searching, or go silent?
Did I repair aloud, or trail off?
Did I apologise for my English?
Did I hand the turn back at least twice?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on conversation management. (1) Mark every taking, holding, yielding and repair move. (2) Flag where I trailed off instead of repairing. (3) Flag any apology for my own English. (4) Give me three natural time-buying phrases at C1 that I did not use. Do not rewrite the text.
